summary: The maintained customer-agent draft creation and revision path required a raw bearer and opened its own transaction, preventing a Task worker from applying the same native Session/Registration/Foundation authority atomically. Add a source-pinned session-bound adapter, dry capture and non-locking current verification on the canonical authority/mutations; reject historical UUID receipt rebinding.
rollback: Scoped revert of this adapter/common-helper refactor, restoring prior public service path; no migration or runtime activation to undo.
